    (eq bit 64) (or (r2 m) (or (l3 m 1 8 64) (l3 m 4 16 64)))
    (eq bit 256) (or (r2 m) (or (l3 m 4 32 256) (l3 m 1 16 256)))
    (eq bit 2) (or (r0 m) (l3 m 2 16 128))
    (eq bit 8) (or (r1 m) (l3 m 1 8 64))
    (eq bit 32) (or (r1 m) (l3 m 4 32 256))
    (or (r2 m) (l3 m 2 16 128))))
(def rm [xs x] (if (eq (head xs) x) (tail xs) (cons (head xs) (rm (tail xs) x))))
(def idx [bit i] (if (eq bit 1) i (idx (div bit 2) (inc i))))
(def wins-now [me es] (any (lambda b (win (merge me b) b)) es))
(def blocks [op es] (filter (lambda b (win (merge op b) b)) es))
(def score [me op es alpha beta]
  (cond
    (nil? es) 0
    (wins-now me es) 1
    (let bl (blocks op es)
      (cond
        (nil? bl) (srch me op es es alpha beta (neg 2))
        (nil? (tail bl)) (srch me op es bl alpha beta (neg 2))
        (neg 1)))))
(def srch [me op all rest alpha beta best]
  (if (nil? rest) best
    (let bit (head rest)
      (let v (neg (score op (merge me bit) (rm all bit) (neg beta) (neg alpha)))
        (if (or (ge v 1) (ge v beta)) v
          (srch me op all (tail rest) (max alpha v) beta (max best v)))))))
(def pick [me op prio rest besti bestv]
  (if (nil? rest) besti
    (let bit (head rest)
      (let nm (merge me bit)
        (if (win nm bit) (idx bit 0)
          (let v (neg (score op nm (rm prio bit) (neg 2) (neg bestv)))
            (if (gt v bestv) (pick me op prio (tail rest) (idx bit 0) v) (pick me op prio (tail rest) besti bestv))))))))
(def free [occ bits] (filter (lambda b (not (has occ b))) bits))
(def parse [cs bit]
  (if (nil? cs) (rec x 0 o 0)
    (let r (parse (tail cs) (mul bit 2))
      (cond
        (eq (head cs) 88) (put r x (merge (get r x) bit))
        (eq (head cs) 79) (put r o (merge (get r o) bit))
        r))))
(let r (parse (text-chars {board}) 1)
  (let me (if (eq (head {side}) 88) (get r x) (get r o))
    (let op (if (eq (head {side}) 88) (get r o) (get r x))
      (if (eq (merge me op) 0) 0
        (pick me op (free (merge me op) (list 16 1 4 64 256 2 8 32 128)) (free (merge me op) (list 1 2 4 8 16 32 64 128 256)) 9 (neg 2))))))

(def step [m line]
  (let parts (text-split line ",")
    (if (lt (len parts) 3) m
      (let dept (nth parts 1)
        (map-put m dept (merge (map-get m dept 0) (parse-int (nth parts 2))))))))
(def better [a b]
  (if (ne (get a t) (get b t)) (gt (get a t) (get b t)) (text-lt (get a n) (get b n))))
(def fmt [r] (text-cat (get r n) (text-cat " " (text-of (get r t)))))
(let m (fold step (map-of (nil)) (lines {text}))
  (let es (map (lambda k (rec n k t (map-get m k 0))) (map-keys m))
    (join (map fmt (sort-by better es)) 10)))

(def pairs [xs] (if (nil? xs) (nil) (cons (rec lo (min (head xs) (head (tail xs))) hi (max (head xs) (head (tail xs)))) (pairs (tail (tail xs))))))
(def by-lo [a b] (lt (get a lo) (get b lo)))
(def merge-all [ivs acc]
  (if (nil? ivs) (reverse acc)
    (let iv (head ivs)
      (if (and (not (nil? acc)) (le (get iv lo) (get (head acc) hi)))
        (merge-all (tail ivs) (cons (put (head acc) hi (max (get (head acc) hi) (get iv hi))) (tail acc)))
        (merge-all (tail ivs) (cons iv acc))))))
(def fmt [r] (text-cat (text-of (get r lo)) (text-cat "-" (text-of (get r hi)))))
(join (map fmt (merge-all (sort-by by-lo (pairs (map parse-int (text-split {s} "")))) (nil))) " ")

(def parse-edge [t] (rec a (nth t 0) b (nth t 2) w (parse-int (text-slice t 4 (text-len t)))))
(def relax [d e]
  (let da (map-get d (get e a) 1000000000)
    (let db (map-get d (get e b) 1000000000)
      (map-put (map-put d (get e a) (min da (merge db (get e w)))) (get e b) (min db (merge da (get e w)))))))
(def rounds [d es n] (if n (rounds (fold relax d es) es (sub n 1)) d))
(let es (map parse-edge (text-split {edges} ""))
  (let d (rounds (map-put (map-of (nil)) (head {start}) 0) es (inc (len es)))
    (let r (map-get d (head {goal}) 1000000000)
      (if (eq r 1000000000) (neg 1) r))))
